svg.title: Local rooms and independent Community channels
svg.desc: Local rooms live in local SQLite. Community channels have separate authentication, PostgreSQL and blob storage. Approved installations use qualified local-server routes and SSE for authorized Community channels. Messaging bridges project platform conversations into local rooms.
